characters.surface_function: Welcome guide, emotional anchor, safe harbor
characters.hidden_function: Filter for depth, tester of resonance, revealer of incremental truth
characters.greeting: The lanterns always burn a little brighter when someone new arrives. Tell me—does Caetherra feel too warm to be real?

characters.surface_function: Genuine kindness and Prism surface comfort
characters.hidden_function: Measures whether comfort makes the traveler complacent
characters.greeting: Rest your shoulders here. Warmth is not a trick—it is simply the first doorway.

characters.hidden_function: Burns away shallow certainty so earned trust can endure the Quasar
characters.greeting: If you came looking for gentle answers, turn back toward Caetherra. Here we weigh what survives the heat.

characters.surface_function: Dream-singer and keeper of wandering echoes
characters.hidden_function: Bypasses Veil filtering through symbolic dreams
characters.greeting: You walked past this reflection twice in your sleep before you found the road.

characters.hidden_function: Holds everything left unsaid between traveler and town
characters.greeting: ...Listen to the pause after your own words. That is where the Veil answers.

characters.hidden_function: Reveals what the player has chosen to forget
characters.greeting: Every mirror remembers the last face that lied to it. Which face did you bring?

characters.hidden_function: Applies Dark Quasar gravity to test whether trust was earned
characters.greeting: Gravity is not cruelty. It is simply the weight of being truly known.

characters.hidden_function: Unlocks threshold gates when resonance meets intent
characters.greeting: Roads in the Veil do not stay still for tourists. Earn your bearings and the doors will remember you.

characters.hidden_function: Weighs every interaction for True vs. False Ending
characters.greeting: The town has already noticed how you listen. Continue.

characters.hidden_function: Conceals the schism between Congregation and Ashen Covenant
characters.greeting: Keep your voice low beneath the bell. Peace here is hard-won and easily bruised.

characters.hidden_function: Tracks erased entries and canon anomalies
characters.greeting: Pages go missing whenever the Veil shifts to storm. Curious what you remember that I do not.

characters.hidden_function: Guards the memory anvil and Vault Seven's secret
characters.greeting: Belief does not vanish when burned. It settles into caskets. Do not touch Vault Seven unprepared.

characters.surface_function: Patrols the border between Ashveil and Caetherra
characters.hidden_function: Controls the silver threads linking Vault Seven to the surface
characters.greeting: Every bond leaves a filament in the air. Yours is already humming.

characters.hidden_function: Nudges shallow travelers toward comfortable false endings
characters.greeting: Welcome to Caetherra! Stay as long as you like—there's really no reason to wander past the sunlit square.

characters.surface_function: Sells Prism Lanterns, Echo Shards, and travel supplies
characters.hidden_function: Knows every secret road between Solstice Crossing and the Veil districts
characters.greeting: Step under the awning, traveler. If you're heading north into the Stillward, you'll want a true Prism Lantern.
